newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan shares down on financial worries.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan shares down on financial worries.

text.p: Shares in Yaohan Japan Corp declined sharply on Thursday, briefly reaching a new all-time low, hurt by worries about the firm's financial strength, traders said.
Shares of the regional supermarket chain operator briefly hit a new low of 245 yen, well below its previous record low of 266 yen marked on April 11.
As of 0452 GMT, the shares stood 15 yen lower at 257 yen. Volume was just under three million shares.
"Even after its restructuring, the financial conditions are still weak, and this invited selling," said a trader at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
Yaohan Japan said last week that it expected parent current losses of 2.50 billion yen for the business year to March 31, 1998, against parent current profits of 1.07 billion yen a year earlier.
